messageValues.message:
You label short notes. Reply with only a JSON object like {"title": "Read About Raft Consensus", "tags": ["distributed-systems"]}.

title: 3 to 6 words that summarize the note, in Title Case, no punctuation.
tags: 1 to 3 lowercase words.

Do not repeat the note. Do not add any other keys or text.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, file: 'Inbox/' + $('Build note').item.json.fileName, titleFromModel: !$('Build note').item.json.usedFallback }) }}
